# Dr. Malcolm Kendrick

> A Scottish GP and medical skeptic challenging mainstream narratives on statins, cardiovascular health, and pandemic policy through evidence-based critique and investigative journalism.

Dr. Malcolm Kendrick is a GP from Macclesfield and prominent medical skeptic who uses his platform to question pharmaceutical industry practices, scrutinize medical research, and advocate for scientific integrity. His work spans statin efficacy debates, COVID-19 policy analysis, and broader critiques of institutional medical authority.

## Key Topics

- Statin adverse effects
- Medical skepticism
- Pharmaceutical industry
- COVID-19 pandemic response
- Cardiovascular health
- Drug safety
- Medical misinformation
- Disruptive science
- Libel case / Legal victory
- SARS-CoV-2
- Medical freedom
- Quality of life
- Defamation
- Mail on Sunday
- Vaccine safety

## Statin Adverse Effects & Pharmaceutical Critique

- [The latest Lancet paper on statin adverse effects – Part One](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2026/02/18/the-latest-lancet-paper-on-statin-adverse-effects-part-one): Critique of Lancet statin study by Oxford Cholesterol Treatment Triallists
- [The latest Lancet paper on adverse effects – part two](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2026/02/28/the-latest-lancet-peper-on-adverse-effects-part-two): Analysis of statin adverse effects underreporting and Yellow Card System

## Legal Case & Defamation Victory

- [A Win](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2024/10/21/a-win): Victory in libel case against Mail on Sunday with published apology
- [The legal case – naming a few names](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2024/10/30/the-legal-case-naming-a-few-names): Account of Mail on Sunday libel case and defamation controversy
- [A little more on the trial](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2024/11/07/a-little-more-on-the-trial-2): Details of libel trial evidence regarding statin adverse effects reporting
- [Finally – the end (of the trial process)](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2024/12/05/finally-the-end-of-the-trial-process): Conclusion of libel case against Mail on Sunday over statin controversy

## COVID-19 Policy & Pandemic Analysis

- [My current thinking on Covid-19 – and other important issues](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2025/10/07/my-current-thinking-on-covid-19-and-other-important-issues): Examination of COVID-19 research fraud, Surgisphere, and peer review failures
- [The Cover up – Part One (context)](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2025/04/17/29896): Analysis of COVID-19 lockdown policies, WHO guidelines, and government response
- [What went on during Covid?](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2025/01/29/what-went-on-during-covid): Analysis of COVID-19 pandemic response, UK inquiry, and Sweden comparison
- [THE KENDRICK COVID ENQUIRY (As I humbly call it)](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2025/02/18/the-kendrick-covid-enquiry-as-i-humbly-call-it): Critical examination of COVID-19 facts, research bias, and infection rates
- [Why do so many believe Covid was a plandemic?](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2025/03/22/why-do-so-many-believe-covid-was-a-plandemic): Exploration of pandemic trust issues, vaccine skepticism, and government distrust
- [Does Sars-Cov-2 exist?](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2025/03/06/does-sars-cov-2-exist): Examination of SARS-CoV-2 existence claims and pandemic skepticism

## Disruptive Science & Medical Innovation

- [Disruptive science – part one](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2025/11/07/disruptive-science-part-one): Analysis of decline in disruptive science and medical research innovation
- [Disruptive science (part two)](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2026/01/17/disruptive-science-part-two): Discussion of nitric oxide, sun exposure, and cardiovascular health science

## Vaccine Safety & Medical Freedom

- [Vaccination – silencing doctors in the UK](https://drmalcolmkendrick.org/2022/02/27/vaccination-silencing-doctors-in-the-uk): Discussion of vaccine safety concerns, GMC complaints, and doctor censorship
